title: Production P0 auth-mail runtime directory authority reconciliation
acceptance: the owner-only command is accepted only on release issue 3072 and exact current main is rechecked before any REG.RU mutation
missing complete Resend or SMTP production secrets fails with MAIL_CREDENTIALS_MISSING before SSH and before production mutation
the protected PC_PROD_HOST must be nonempty, must equal one of the live domain's current DNS IPv4 answers and must present the pinned SSH host fingerprint

the provisioner selects protected PC_PROD_DIR only with the same paired PC_PROD_COMPOSE condition used by the exact full-stack release; when that directory differs from the active Web label, a valid root-owned runtime pair is moved once into the canonical directory without regeneration or disclosure
distinct random 96-hex PASSWORD_RESET_DELIVERY_KEY and REGISTRATION_DELIVERY_KEY values are stored in one root-owned 0600 file and injected into API and Web without disclosure
one allowlisted Resend or SMTP environment file is stored root-owned 0600 and injected only into Web
existing protected files must be valid and are preserved idempotently; symlinks, broad paths, malformed values and unsafe permissions fail closed
workflow logs and retained artifacts publish only safe created/existing, channel and validity markers and never secret values
the exact full-stack release refuses to proceed unless both protected runtime files are valid, preserves least privilege and verifies immutable matching API/Web revisions
emergency rollback and verify-intake remain independent of the newly provisioned files and restore the recorded baseline override without injecting them

post-release read-only diagnostics must prove API URL, both registration and password-reset delivery keys in API and Web, per-purpose equality, cross-purpose separation and transactional mail readiness before a new browser request
production hosting remains the existing REG.RU contour and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
